about_the_game:
The BARHEIM soundtrack contains all the background music heard in the game. Each track provides a fun and colorful take on each of the five realms you traverse as you encounter and interact with the generals of Queen Yrsa and Hustler Divine LLC, and even Queen Yrsa herself! Immerse yourself in the world of BARHEIM now!

Features:

  • 19 original tracks produced in-house by Dusk Wave Arts

  • Available in Mp3 format

  • An emotional soundtrack that carries the world of the game beyond the screen
